mode: read-only conceptual adaptation; no execution, deployment, data or credential copy from GCN
permission: owner explicitly requested examining nearby GCN chat ideas/solutions and using applicable ones
license: no relicensing or assertion of general open-source rights; explicit same-owner reuse request
adopted_patterns: compact explicit session state and topic repair
explicit new topic overrides stale context
bounded grounded draft separate from conversational composition
state promotion tied to delivered answer
session-window judging with evidence and media, not isolated copywriting
fail-closed missing/partial provider assessment; advisory scores only

applied_to_pa.topic_precedence: /new removes expiring context; supplied-turn context explicitly yields to current request/topic change
